subject: Fix unit test issues on address sanitizer and fortify (#437)
reason: The change only edits CI workflow steps (.github/workflows/daily.yml) and unit-test source files (src/unit/test_crc64combine.c, src/unit/test_intset.c): an uninitialized-variable fix in a test benchmark helper, removal of a leaked duplicate intsetNew() call in a test, and GCC pragmas suppressing a fortify false positive. No code compiled into valkey-server or the tools changes, so no command, replication, persistence or cluster behaviour differs between the builds; there is nothing a scenario could exercise.
